caption: We asked Perplexity Computer to build a tactical studio from 25 Hz tracking data of Bayern Munich's 2023 title decider.
tts: We asked Perplexity Computer to build a tactical studio from twenty-five hertz tracking data of Bayern Munich's twenty twenty-three title decider.

caption: Every 40 milliseconds, the browser streams all 22 players and computes a velocity-weighted Spearman pitch-control field.
tts: Every forty milliseconds, the browser streams all twenty-two players and computes a velocity-weighted Spearman pitch-control field.

caption: Freeze at 88:11, three seconds before the winning goal. Serge Gnabry holds the ball on the left wing with ten pass options.
tts: Freeze at eighty-eight eleven, three seconds before the winning goal. Serge Gnabry holds the ball on the left wing with ten pass options.

caption: The model ranks Joao Cancelo #1 at 93% completion, while Jamal Musiala near the box is second at 65%.
tts: The model ranks Joao Cancelo number one at ninety-three percent completion, while Jamal Musiala near the box is second at sixty-five percent.

caption: Switching to Split 2D+3D view pairs the top-down tactical pitch with a 3D Spidercam stadium perspective.
tts: Switching to split two-D and three-D view pairs the top-down tactical pitch with a three-D Spidercam stadium perspective.

caption: In full 3D Broadcast mode, you can switch from Spidercam to TV Broadcast or drop into Serge Gnabry's carrier point of view.
tts: In full three-D broadcast mode, you can switch from Spidercam to TV Broadcast or drop into Serge Gnabry's carrier point of view.

caption: From Gnabry's left-wing perspective, glowing 3D corridors show the 93% lane to Cancelo and 65% lane to Musiala.
tts: From Gnabry's left-wing perspective, glowing three-D corridors show the ninety-three percent lane to Cancelo and sixty-five percent lane to Musiala.

caption: Now test a counterfactual what-if: drag Cologne midfielder Eric Martel 9.4 meters south into Cancelo's lane.
tts: Now test a counterfactual what-if: drag Cologne midfielder Eric Martel nine point four meters south into Cancelo's lane.

caption: An amber ghost trail marks Martel's 9.4 m shift as his control pocket drops Cancelo from 93% to 0%.
tts: An amber ghost trail marks Martel's nine point four meter shift as his control pocket drops Cancelo from ninety-three percent to zero.

caption: In the live pass table, Cancelo drops from #1 to #7 as blocked, promoting Jamal Musiala to #1 at 70% completion.
tts: In the live pass table, Cancelo drops from first to seventh as blocked, promoting Jamal Musiala to number one at seventy percent completion.

caption: Replaying that drag in Split 2D+3D view shows the 3D gold corridor shift off Cancelo and lock onto Musiala.
tts: Replaying that drag in split two-D and three-D view shows the three-D gold corridor shift off Cancelo and lock onto Musiala.

caption: Testing the second preset pulls Martel 10 meters deeper toward midfield, opening Musiala's pocket up to 73% completion.
tts: Testing the second preset pulls Martel ten meters deeper toward midfield, opening Musiala's pocket up to seventy-three percent completion.

caption: Toggling Shape and Pass Value shows Cologne's 532 m² block, Bayern's 1,036 m² hull, and expected-threat zones.
tts: Toggling Shape and Pass Value shows Cologne's five hundred thirty-two square meter block, Bayern's hull, and expected-threat zones.

caption: Rolling the 25 Hz tracking data forward from 88:11, Gnabry plays that pass to Musiala, who turns and scores the 88:14 winner.
tts: Rolling the twenty-five hertz tracking data forward from eighty-eight eleven, Gnabry plays that pass to Musiala, who turns and scores the eighty-eight fourteen winner.

caption: Every equation and Python verification receipt across 701 tracking frames is documented inside the Models and Data drawer.
tts: Every equation and Python verification receipt across seven hundred one tracking frames is documented inside the Models and Data drawer.

caption: Pressing Matters turns static match coordinates into an interactive 2D and 3D tactical studio, built with Perplexity Computer.
tts: Pressing Matters turns static match coordinates into an interactive two-D and three-D tactical studio, built with Perplexity Computer.
